capabilities.text: Fleetio's API has a POST /v2/work_orders endpoint that creates a new work order
Fleetio's API can retrieve the details of an existing work order
Fleetio supports 50+ webhook events including vehicle status changes, issue creation and resolution, and work order completion
Requirement: Fleetio API uses REST with API key and Account-Token header authentication

headline: A custom AI receptionist that works with Fleetio.

howItWorks.body: When a caller rings in, the agent takes the call and collects the details required to open a work order in Fleetio. Booking follows your own rules — your hours, your capacity, and what the agent won't do. You control what the agent says and does, and changes are made when you ask for them.
howItWorks.title: Answers calls and gathers what's needed

howItWorks.body: Prestique connects the agent to Fleetio's API so it can create a new work order using Fleetio's POST /v2/work_orders endpoint and retrieve the details of an existing work order using the GET /v2/work_orders/:id endpoint. The agent only does what Fleetio's API allows and what you have approved it to do.
howItWorks.title: Creates and checks work orders in Fleetio

howItWorks.body: After a call, the agent can follow up by text message. Anything outside its scope goes to your team with a summary of the call. You keep the software you already use — the agent works with Fleetio rather than replacing it.
howItWorks.title: Follows up and hands off

intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses. For shops that run Fleetio, the agent connects to Fleetio's API so it can create new work orders and retrieve details of existing ones, within what that API allows.

The agent answers calls when your team can't — after hours and when the line is busy. Every call is recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed. Anything the agent shouldn't handle goes to your team with a summary of the call.
metaDescription: What a custom AI receptionist from Prestique can do with Fleetio, based on Fleetio's own published API documentation.
